about: P37D T1: nouns jurors write that the PLAY catalog cannot draw. Sentences from the sets below (the sealed test-200 and p43/sealed-100 are never read) plus evals/play/p37d/common-nouns.json; one bin per word, in this order: covered (catalog id, tag or hero identity, or a checklist match word), undrawable (abstract), not-nouns.txt (dropped), missing, settings (drawn by the scene), unclassified (belongs on a list, not in production). missing is ranked by sentence count, then by the common-nouns order; category is the model class the word reveals (P43). Written by scripts/p37d/missing-nouns.mjs.
